name: iGEM Waterloo
description: Engineers biological processes using principles from synthetic biology, competing in the International Genetically Engineered Machine competition.

cycles.notes: Recruits once a year in January, not in the fall: the join page's timeline shows main team applications opening the first week of January and closing about two weeks later, with interviews and decisions through February. The page currently shows 'Applications have closed for 2025', the 2027 dates aren't posted yet. Watch their social media for the announcement. Undergraduate team, competing since 2005.
